name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete Qiskit program demonstr
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a complete Qiskit program demonstrating the effect of depolarizing noise (p1=0.0076, p2=0.0319) on a GHZ state using AerSimulator and a custom NoiseModel. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
